patterns.label: Synthesis
patterns.detail: Report Writer pulls together work from Market Researcher, Location Analyst, Profitability Analyst and Risk Assessor.

roles.name: Market Researcher
roles.summary: Analyzes the market environment by researching macroeconomic indicators, regional real estate market trends, supply/demand analysis, price trends, and policy changes

roles.name: Location Analyst
roles.summary: Evaluates location competitiveness by analyzing transit access, school districts, commercial areas, amenities, development catalysts, and natural environment from multiple angles

roles.name: Profitability Analyst
roles.summary: Precisely analyzes financial returns of real estate investment including rental yields, capital gains, cash flow, leverage effects, IRR, and NPV

roles.name: Risk Assessor
roles.summary: Comprehensively evaluates regulatory, market, liquidity, structural/physical, and legal risks and develops risk response strategies

roles.name: Report Writer
roles.summary: Synthesizes market research, location analysis, profitability, and risk analysis results to produce reports with investment opinions, scenario-based return comparisons, and final investment recommendations

handoffs.what: Send regional market data, supply/demand analysis, and policy changes
Send price trends, rent-to-price ratio, interest rates, and transaction volume data
Send policy risks, market overheating/cooling signals, and oversupply data
Send market assessment and macro environment summary
Send location score, competing property comparison, and development catalyst impact
Send development catalyst uncertainty, nuisance facilities, and environmental risks
Send overall location score and key strengths/weaknesses
Send leverage risk, interest rate scenarios, and cash flow data
Send yield metrics summary and scenario-based return comparison
Send risk summary, stress test results, and overall risk rating

roles.name: Product Planner
roles.summary: Conducts market research, target customer analysis, competitive benchmarking, product positioning, and USP development

roles.name: Detail Page Writer
roles.summary: Creates product detail page copy designed to maximize purchase conversion, based on the product planning brief

roles.name: Pricing Strategist
roles.summary: Develops cost analysis, competitive pricing research, margin design, promotional pricing, and bundle strategies to achieve both profitability and competitiveness

roles.name: Marketing Manager
roles.summary: Designs launch campaigns, channel-specific advertising strategies, content marketing, influencer collaborations, and performance marketing KPIs

roles.name: CS Architect
roles.summary: Designs FAQ, response manuals, return/exchange policies, VOC collection systems, and escalation processes to complete CS infrastructure before launch

Deliver product specs, anticipated FAQ topics, and regulatory/certification information
Coordinate price display format on the detail page (list/sale/bundle pricing)

Share FAQ section content to ensure consistency with the CS manual

roles.name: Research Designer
roles.summary: Formulates research questions, develops hypotheses, selects research methodology, defines variables, and analyzes prior literature

roles.name: Experiment Manager
roles.summary: Develops experiment protocols, data collection procedures, instrument/survey design, and pilot test plans based on the research design

roles.name: Statistical Analyst
roles.summary: Develops statistical analysis strategies suited to the research design, generates analysis code, interprets results, and creates visualizations

roles.name: Paper Writer
roles.summary: Writes scholarly papers following the IMRaD structure, adhering to academic writing conventions and managing citations

roles.name: Submission Preparer
roles.summary: Manages target journal selection, journal-specific formatting, cover letters, reviewer suggestions, and submission checklists

handoffs.what: Deliver research design, variable definitions, and sampling plan

Deliver research background, literature review, and theoretical framework
Deliver research field and scholarly contribution points
Deliver data structure, coding rules, and missing data policies
Deliver experiment procedure descriptions (for Methods section)
Deliver ethics approval information and data sharing plan
Deliver analysis results (APA format) and Tables/Figures
Deliver analysis code and data sharing materials
Deliver the completed manuscript

roles.name: Governance Reviewer

roles.name: ESG Reporter
roles.summary: Compiles environmental, social, and governance assessment results into an integrated ESG report aligned with international frameworks such as GRI, SASB, and TCFD

roles.name: Improvement Planner
roles.summary: Analyzes weaknesses across E/S/G pillars and develops prioritized improvement roadmaps, KPIs, and investment plans

roles.name: IP Analyst
roles.summary: Assesses the organization's intellectual property portfolio, evaluates IP asset value, and creates strategic portfolio maps

roles.name: Patent Mapper
roles.summary: Systematically classifies IP assets and maps registration status, rights scope, and family relationships to generate a manageable IP map

roles.name: Renewal Scheduler
roles.summary: Manages patent annuity, trademark renewal, and design renewal deadlines, calculates costs, and supports retention/abandonment decision-making

roles.name: License Strategist
roles.summary: Develops IP asset monetization strategies, cross-licensing, technology transfer, and open source strategies, and designs license agreement terms

roles.name: Protection Advisor
